title: Everyone sees the same canteen and all-hands
description: In the virtual office, a member used to see only their own department at lunch and at the Friday all-hands, while team leaders and above saw everybody. At lunch, 12 to 1, and at the all-hands, Fridays 4 to 5 PM, everyone now sees the same room, with everybody who is in sitting in the same seats under their names.
items: The all-hands has the same presenter on everyone's screen
Other departments' rooms stay closed, whatever the hour
For someone in another department, a member sees their name and that they are in, never their times or leave
pending: Needs its database update: paste supabase/migrations/20261102090000_p17_08_office_gatherings.sql into the Supabase SQL editor. Until then, a member still sees only their own department in those rooms.
